book.name: 2 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Labuina Pol wana Leleli

content: Pol I Baaba wana Tuwalali ana Sinalian kaiwena

Gamagalau enuna hi baaba kaiweu hi ba, “Sauga Pol i miminaa eliyala i lolovakun ge i babaa hinahinan, yaa ebo ana bwaga i yapu abwe atena i mamatuwa ge wana baaba i gagasisi.” Inoke Keliso wana hanalau ge wana pagan meimeina eliyana nau Pol ya awanun eliyamiu.

Ya awanun sauga ebo na nowa, nuku matahikagimiu te bahi wami pagan kaiwena ge no baaba ni gagasisi eliyamiu. He ya atena bosowaiu no baaba ni gasisi alomiyau elal, bolo hi ba tage panayawi ana nuwanuwatu elana ha nanawaa.
Tunahot ha minaa panayawi, yaa nige tage panayawi ana nuwanuwatu elana ha lohaveyan.
Wama elohaveyan nige i oola panayawi ana elohaveyan, yaa wama elohaveyan ana gasisi i neem Yehoba elana ge bosowaina topihigelgel wali abamina gasigasisena ni apapanak-an.

Nuwatu kakakawel ge baaba hanahanahail ha lekaleka-an, bolo gamagalau i patupal Yehoba ana aatena bahi ni gagan elal. Gamagalau wali nuwatu gegewena ha ahel ge ha yowanil, inoke wali nuwatu elana Keliso wana nuwatu nihi henapuan.
Ge sauga ebo wama baaba gegewena nuku henapuan, he ama iyaka ha lovivina haba te gamagalau bolo wama baaba hi towani naha lahel.

Bugul bolo ku kiteliya matamiwa nuku nuwanuwatu-agil bubun! Ebo gamagal etega iyehe ei i nuwatu iya Keliso wana totuwalali, he ni nuwatu bubun ge ni atena te ama al Keliso wana totuwalali ha ola ya te iya.
Babala gasisi i pem eliyama ge naha tuwalali. Tabam kekeisi ha ba heyagima gasisi o kaiwena, yaa Babala i pem wami abulilek naha tal, nige tage naha kukulekaleka-an, inoke nige naha pupuluwawi-an.
Yaa nige nuwau te nuku nuwatu tage ya palopalovakun no leta eliyalil.
He gamagalau enuna hi ba, “Pol wana leleli i gasisi ge i pulowan, yaa sauga ebo ta kite matalaa, nige wana gasisi i gagan ge iya tobaaba bwagabwaga ya.”
Gamagalau bolo o nihi atena te sauga ebo naha nowa, wama ginol ni olaolaek te wama baaba leta elal sauga ama bwaga i yapu eliyamiu.

Alomiyau enuna totoliya hi awa wawaisi-agil eliyamiu. Bahi ama naha ba alomeyau ha olaolaek, he alaliya iyaka i bwaya luwagima! Yaa age hi neganega hot. He totoliya ali luvi hi teli ge eliyana hi peluviluvi-agil, avaliyau wali pagan eliyana totoliya wali pagan hi luviluvi-an ge ali awa wawaisi hi giginol.
Yaa ama nige bosowaina ama luvi naha likaan ge totoma naha ba heyagima. Naha babaa ya te tuwalali toto Yehoba i pem eliyama ana luvi elana. He tuwalali o gamwana etegana te komiu Kolinita.

Binimala nige naha nonowa eliyamiu, he bosowaina te ama topihigelgel nihi ba, “Ali luvi hi likaan ge hi ba haha nabiyan hot.” Yaa nige i oola, kaiwena ama te ha nowa houwa eliyamiu ge Keliso Wasana Waiwaisana ha papaatena-an eliyamiu.

Wama ba haha ha luviya ya te tuwalali toto ha ginol elana, nige gamagalau gegetogal wali tuwalali elana i oola. Ge atema i matuwa te wami abulilek iyoho ya i gagasisi nawa, inoke abwe nuku labema ge wama tuwalali ni siun ge ni bwabwata nawa.

Nuwama Wasa Waiwaisana naha papaatena-an labi bolo hi minek Kolinita labena yalasa. He nige bosowaima naha nok panuwa bolo avalau hi tuwalali-an haba elal, ge naha ba heyagima gamagal getoga wana tuwalali enowana elana.
Yaa i ola Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba toto i ba, “Henala ebo nuwana ni ba haha, he Babala te ni teli heyan.”
He nige tage bolo totoliya hi awa wawaisi-agil alaliya i gan Yehoba matanaa, yaa bolo iya i awa wawaisi-agil te alaliya i gan matanaa.
